llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文完全未涉及人工智能在生物打印中的应用。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI into any bioprinting workflow stage, nor does it involve experimental validation of AI models or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发适合软骨再生的生物墨水。
summary_zh.method: 将胶原和海藻酸钠混合制备生物墨水。
summary_zh.result: 实现了软骨细胞的三维打印并保持活性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞活力和组织学染色验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a suitable bioink for cartilage tissue engineering using 3D cell printing.
summary_en.method: Collagen and alginate were blended to formulate a bioink for printing chondrocytes.
summary_en.result: The printed constructs maintained cell viability and supported cartilage-like tissue formation.
summary_en.validation: Cell viability assays and histological staining were performed.

papers.title: Gaussian process-based surrogate modeling framework for process planning in laser powder-bed fusion additive manufacturing of 316L stainless steel
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering, Texas A&M University, College Station, TX, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Gustavo Tapia
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering, Texas A&M University, College Station, TX, USA

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法使用高斯过程代理模型替代昂贵有限元仿真，可迁移至生物力学设计中植入物优化问题。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or patient-specific modeling; focused on manufacturing process parameters rather than structural performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 为高效优化激光粉末床熔融工艺参数，避免昂贵实验。
summary_zh.method: 基于有限元仿真数据训练高斯过程代理模型预测熔池几何与温度。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型准确预测熔池尺寸与温度，实现工艺参数快速优化。
summary_zh.validation: 316L不锈钢单道激光熔化实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize process parameters in laser powder-bed fusion additive manufacturing without costly experiments.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process surrogate model is trained on finite element simulation data to predict melt pool geometry and temperature distribution.
summary_en.result: The surrogate accurately predicts melt pool dimensions and temperatures, enabling rapid process parameter optimization.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation using single-track laser melting on 316L stainless steel.

papers.title: Numerical modelling and experimental validation in Selective Laser Melting

corresponding_authors.name: Eric Neiva
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Centre Internacional de Mètodes Numèrics en Enginyeria (CIMNE), Building C1, Campus Nord UPC, Gran Capitán S/N, E-08034 Barcelona, Spain

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究SLM数值建模与实验验证，未涉及生物医学植入物或应力屏蔽等方向。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no porous structure design, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对SLM工艺进行数值建模并实验验证。
summary_zh.method: 采用数值模拟与实验对比方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验数据验证数值模型。

summary_en.motivation: This paper aims to develop numerical models for the Selective Laser Melting process and validate them experimentally.
summary_en.method: The study employs numerical simulations and compares them with experimental measurements.
summary_en.result: The models show good agreement with experimental data, confirming their accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through direct comparison of simulation results with experimental observations from SLM builds.

papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical and Chemical Engineering, The University of Western Australia, Crawley, Australia

corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical and Chemical Engineering, The University of Western Australia, Crawley, Australia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及抗菌钛合金的增材制造，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与用户研究方向关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure for stiffness matching, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration, which are core to the user's AM biomedical implant direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 制备具有抗菌功能的钛合金植入物。
summary_zh.method: 利用选区激光熔化技术添加抗菌剂。
summary_zh.result: 成功实现体外抗菌效果。

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate antibacterial titanium implants for reducing infection risk.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to incorporate antibacterial agents into titanium.
summary_en.result: The produced titanium exhibited effective antibacterial properties in vitro.
summary_en.validation: In vitro antibacterial assays confirmed the bactericidal effect.

papers.title: New Development in Selective Laser Melting of Ti–6Al–4V: A Wider Processing Window for the Achievement of Fully Lamellar α + β Microstructures
papers.first_author_affiliation: Centre for Additive Manufacturing, School of Engineering, RMIT University, Melbourne, VIC, 3000, Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Edward W. Lui
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Centre for Additive Manufacturing, School of Engineering, RMIT University, Melbourne, VIC, 3000, Australia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及SLM工艺参数对Ti-6Al-4V微观组织的影响，未涉及多孔结构、应力屏蔽或疲劳性能，与AM生物医用材料方向间接相关。
llm.why_not_core: Does not link porous structure to stress shielding, no mechanical testing, no fatigue, no surface morphology or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 扩展SLM工艺窗口以获得全层状α+β组织
summary_zh.method: 通过调整激光参数进行SLM实验
summary_zh.result: 实现了更宽工艺窗口内的全层状组织
summary_zh.validation: 金相观察验证微观组织

summary_en.motivation: To expand the processing window for selective laser melting to achieve fully lamellar α+β microstructure.
summary_en.method: Systematic variation of SLM parameters in Ti-6Al-4V fabrication.
summary_en.result: A wider processing window yielding fully lamellar microstructure was identified.
summary_en.validation: Metallographic analysis confirmed the achieved microstructure.
